newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market steady-up $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market steady-up $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were fully steady, instances $1.00 per cwt higher on aressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choicd 2-3 1250-1300 lbs 110.00, few 109.00. ( weighted average 109.88 )
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1175 lbs 110.00; Choice 111.00. ( weighted average 110.36 )
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was moderate. Few sales both classes fully steady, instances $1.00 higher. Buyer inquiry and demand moderate, seller interest limited.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Wk To Date - 9,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 22,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 6,700
